name: Excalidraw
description: Virtual whiteboard for sketching hand-drawn like diagrams
composeYaml:
services:
  excalidraw:
    image: 'excalidraw/excalidraw:latest'
    environment:
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - wget
        - '--spider'
        - '--quiet'
        - 'http://localhost'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10
